heroes.name: Arjuna
heroes.rule: May use one volley per battle at exactly three cells; resolve it as a Dhanurdhar volley.
heroes.quote: A clear line is worth more than a hurried arrow.
heroes.balance: Grants the host one special volley, not a permanent archer conversion. Normal line/ray and volley immunity rules apply; power ignores host rank. Cannot stack with an astra in one turn.

heroes.name: Karna
heroes.rule: Once, survives a losing melee clash and retreats to his previous empty cell.
heroes.quote: Let my armour buy one more chance to stand.
heroes.balance: Only a valid previous cell that is empty and adjacent permits survival; otherwise he falls. No immunity to Chara first strikes, traps, arrows or astras. No extra strike; reveal him and consume the trait.

heroes.name: Bhima
heroes.rule: Wins equal-strength melee clashes on attack or defence without breaking his shield.
heroes.quote: Hold your ground; I will open the road.
heroes.balance: Compare final effective strength, after normal caps. No effect on unequal clashes, trap, fort, Chara special strike, volley or astra. Overrides the tie setting for this host only.

heroes.name: Abhimanyu
heroes.rule: Ignores enemy Padma defence; cannot move back to his immediately previous cell.
heroes.quote: Show me the opening, and keep the road behind me.
heroes.balance: No automatic fort access or immunity to traps. Only the Padma bonus is ignored. Track the previous cell through ring rotation; voluntary moves and wind swaps cannot evade the restriction. Needs clear move previews.

heroes.name: Ghatotkacha
heroes.rule: Gains one strength in melee at night.
heroes.quote: The dark is quiet enough to hear your next step.
heroes.balance: Uses the existing +2 total bonus cap, on attack and defence. No rank or movement change. Does not alter Chara, trap or fort exceptions. Depict the epic warrior with dignity.

heroes.name: Drona
heroes.rule: Once per battle, reveals one adjacent hidden enemy instead of moving.
heroes.quote: First learn what stands before you; then choose your answer.
heroes.balance: A whole turn, no damage and no new movement. Range one along graph adjacency. Reveal the host when the lesson is invoked so information is not free and anonymous.

heroes.name: Bhishma
heroes.rule: While he has never moved, adjacent allies gain Padma defence with one supporter.
heroes.quote: An army is held together by those who remember the whole field.
heroes.balance: Host counts as the one required fighting supporter. No stacking above normal Padma +1. Rotation counts as movement for this trait even if engine hasMoved remains false; no benefit to forts or traps.

heroes.name: Dhrishtadyumna
heroes.rule: After he breaks the enemy gate, gain one extra Shakti.
heroes.quote: The opening is ours; now bring the army through.
heroes.balance: One bonus on that host’s successful first breach only, respecting the five-Shakti cap. No reward for taking an already breached fort or for fire cast by another piece. Defender still receives its normal breach Shakti.

vows.name: Bhishma’s restraint
vows.condition: Win a duel without your Senapati initiating any attack, volley or targeted damaging astra.
vows.reward: 2 vow stars toward a cosmetic title; no combat benefit.

vows.name: The guarded fort
vows.condition: Win a duel while your own fort gate remains unbroken throughout the battle.
vows.reward: 1 vow star and a cosmetic shield stamp.

vows.name: Clear eyes
vows.condition: Win after your Divyadrishti successfully reveals at least two different enemies.
vows.reward: 1 vow star and a cosmetic scout stamp.

vows.name: The patient engineer
vows.condition: Win after a Yantrik survives dismantling at least one Shataghni.
vows.reward: 1 vow star and a cosmetic engineer stamp.

vows.name: The open road
vows.condition: Win after one Rath makes two noncapturing moves of at least three cells each.
vows.reward: 1 vow star and a cosmetic chariot stamp.

vows.name: Dawn watch
vows.condition: Win after making at least one capture in both day and night.
vows.reward: 2 vow stars and a cosmetic sky stamp.

vows.name: Joined hands
vows.condition: Win after at least two successful melee captures with a Makara attack bonus.
vows.reward: 1 vow star and a cosmetic formation stamp.

vows.name: Petal guard
vows.condition: Win after an allied piece survives an enemy melee attack while receiving a Padma defence bonus.
vows.reward: 1 vow star and a cosmetic lotus stamp.

vows.name: A single flame
vows.condition: Win a duel after invoking exactly one astra during the entire battle.
vows.reward: 2 vow stars and a cosmetic lamp stamp.

vows.name: Without fire
vows.condition: Win without either Agneyastra or Brahmastra being invoked by your side.
vows.reward: 1 vow star and a cosmetic brass border.

vows.name: Companions return
vows.condition: Win with at least six of your initial fighting pieces still alive.
vows.reward: 2 vow stars and a cosmetic camp stamp.

vows.name: Breach before sunset
vows.condition: Win by taking the enemy fort within 20 rounds in a standard duel.
vows.reward: 2 vow stars and a cosmetic gate stamp.
